role: independent correctness and science/numerics policy review
evidence_class: Static review only. No Rust build, test, physical assembly, solver, replay, or numerical calculation was run by this reviewer.

starting_identity.identity_note: The detached identity is the package's verified starting receipt; this policy review did not rerun its source recorder.

findings.title: Held-direction eligibility and existing fixed/current-active/free masks do not yet have one canonical relationship
findings.evidence: The eligibility list has no fixed/bound/active-state predicate. The plan nevertheless declares an 'active bound' ineligible. The amendment then defines a face free set as physically nonfixed minus D, while the existing solver's current face is state.free: initial nonfixed coordinates minus coordinates activated at lower or upper bounds. Existing KKT classification separately uses initial_free, lower_active, and upper_active. Those are distinct states, so 'physically nonfixed' is insufficient to determine whether a current active coordinate can enter D, whether a base exactly on a bound is eligible before activation, or whether subtracting D may accidentally reintroduce a currently active coordinate.
findings.required_resolution: Before controls or body release, canonical text must state eligibility and precedence separately for an initially fixed coordinate, a coordinate whose base equals a bound but is not yet active, and a currently lower/upper-active coordinate. It must bind each BVLS face to the pre-existing current free set with the held mask applied, preserve initial_free/lower_active/upper_active unchanged, prevent held directions from activation or release in that assembly, and require full 21-coordinate KKT computation/observation including each held coordinate's exact zero contribution. The matching controls must exercise each category and exact error/owner precedence.

findings.title: The authority and controls do not close the complete six-role eligibility universe
findings.evidence: The contracts say only 'reviewed dry leaf or dry stem temperature role'. The plan positively covers G4 upper shade/stem and repeats the same roles for partial wetness; it does not freeze eligibility and exclusion evidence for upper/lower sun leaf, shade leaf, and stem roles as the six role-by-occupancy joins. This leaves room for an implementation keyed to G4's two coordinates or for unintended eligibility of a non-dry-temperature role.
findings.required_resolution: Name the closed role set semantically as sun-leaf, shade-leaf, and dry-stem temperatures for each of the two actual occupancies, still derived from the owning role map rather than numeric indices. Freeze positive and negative role-by-occupancy controls, including positive structural area, structural-zero anchoring, exact fwet==1, partial/near-full wetness, and unexpected zero columns.

findings.title: The control plan is a requirement outline rather than the prospectively frozen finite runnable case inventory
findings.evidence: C01-C09 provide categories but no exact selectors, finite case counts, frozen fixture/input identities, per-case operands, expected dispositions, or execution grouping. C01/C03/C04 are labeled 'actual_assembly_nonphysical' even though they require the owning physical preparation/core Jacobian assembly; this is not the sole result-bearing endpoint, but it is actual physical assembly evidence and must be planned honestly. C07 does not freeze actual natural/selected operands or both full-to-dry and dry-to-full transitions. C10 does not name the runnable expected-red selector or distinguish which new declarations may exist before body while proving a behavioral failure.
findings.required_resolution: Before any expected-red or assembly execution, replace or revise the plan with the exact test selectors, selected counts, frozen operands/fixtures and hashes where applicable, execution class, expected status/disposition, and assertion set. Identify the necessary non-target physical-assembly cases explicitly and keep them distinct from the single later G4 endpoint. Freeze natural, selected, same-J retry, new-base/new-J, full-to-dry, and dry-to-full cases without outcome-driven fixture search.

findings.title: Retained-rank, full-KKT, nonempty-held refinement, and exact work/cap assertions are not sufficiently specified
findings.evidence: C01 asserts a 21x19 shape but not independent full-column-rank 19, exact retained original-ID ordering/factor cardinality, or the unchanged rank threshold over the 19 columns. C02 says KKT consumers are reached but does not require 21 coordinate observations, held-coordinate h/cbar/tau/class evidence, or exact-zero stationarity contribution. C08 covers only D-empty BVLS03/04 identity; it does not cover nonempty D through zero-lambda and positive-lambda refinement, where free_ids, factor/order, p0/p1/p2, held cardinality, work reservations, and scatter must remain aligned. C09 does not freeze exact attempted/completed work and cap expectations for eligibility scanning, 19-column factor work, full-21 KKT, scatter/reconstruction, refusals, and D-empty identity.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze an independent rank-19 oracle for C01; full 21-coordinate KKT assertions; nonempty-D zero- and positive-lambda refinement cases with held +0 bits and 19-entry factor/free/order cardinality at every join; a remaining-dependency refusal; and exact per-case work/cap deltas and precedence. The reduced factor dimension may affect dimensioned numerical work, while full residual/KKT/scatter work remains 21-dimensional; authority and controls must state which existing counters/caps observe each operation and prove no uncounted or duplicate work.

findings.title: SC-VEGETATION-001 changelog version 38 does not match its contract_version metadata
findings.evidence: The new BVLS-05 changelog row declares version 38, while the document front matter remains contract_version: 37. The reported A0 admission did not catch this internal authority-version inconsistency.
findings.required_resolution: Set the canonical contract metadata to version 38 and rerun the applicable authority/schema/reference checks before policy release.

findings.title: The LSE directory contract does not expose or version the new BVLS-05 binding
findings.evidence: The entrypoint remains contract_version 39 and its current changelog ends at BVLS-02. The binding exposure index contains BVLS-02 but no BVLS-05 row, while numerical-methods.md introduces a new prospective binding that controls executable numerical behavior.
findings.required_resolution: Advance the LSE entrypoint metadata consistently, add the BVLS-05 change-log join, and expose the new detached/unpromoted binding in binding-index.md with its governing invariants/obligations and production HOLD. Rerun applicable authority/schema/reference checks.

accepted_policy_core: Eligibility requires role provenance, finite positive structural area, exact fwet==1, and complete exact-zero raw and weighted columns after ordinary guards; no tolerance, singular vector, rank result, fixture, or observed refusal may select it.
The complete 21-row residual, both drainage coordinates, capacity rows, normalizers, scales, bounds, physical equations, and finite-difference probes remain unchanged.
Held increments are +0.0 and reconstruction preserves held base-coordinate bits; every nonlinear trial recomputes wet/dry physics and all residuals.
Each natural, selected, and new-base/new-J assembly derives a fresh mask; same-J radius retry is the only stated retention case.

The remaining free columns retain the existing rank guard and unexplained rank loss remains a typed refusal; no pseudoinverse, clipping, damping, fallback, seed perturbation, or result search is authorized.

external_receipts_not_used_as_closure: bvls05-authority-a0-01 PASS was reported by the orchestrator after review began; it does not resolve the semantic/control findings above.

disposition.note: The structural zero-increment representative is mathematically supportable under the accepted core predicates, but the present authority and plan do not yet constrain the active-face semantics or executable evidence tightly enough for body release.
